patterns: APPSC asks bare numbers: LS max 550 / present 543, RS 250 / 12 nominated, AP RS seats 11 (undivided 18), women in 2009 LS = 59, quorum one-tenth.
Statement-type items test traps: RS not dissolved and 1/3 retire every two years, nominated fields exclude sport, no educational qualification, Anglo-Indian nomination ended by 104th Amdt.
Rajya Sabha special/equal powers recur: Art. 249 authorises Parliament (not State Assemblies), equal status = CAG report + emergency approval, not money bills or VP removal.
Privileges asked via 'which is correct' with civil-only freedom from arrest and both collective and individual privileges.
App MCQs go deeper (2026 delimitation bill, TN resolution, Sita Soren details, article-number matches) than APPSC PYQs, which stay at one-fact level.
